notes:
Fix the agent's Dock icon, floating banners and typing in them on macOS

- The agent sets itself to an accessory app, so it no longer sits in the Dock
  with an icon that can't be quit (launchd restarts it); only the window shows one.
- Banners float above every app and Space, and no longer open as tabs.
- Clicking the banner's text box activates it so keystrokes reach it.
- The longer "appeal" countdown starts only when the user clicks into the text
  box. It used to start whenever the banner was frontmost, which on macOS was
  every time it appeared, so warnings ignored the warning length setting.
